title: WGU Degree Tracker config
description: Shape of window.WGU_TRACKER_CONFIG in config.js. config.js is JavaScript, not JSON: it is `window.WGU_TRACKER_CONFIG = { ... };`. The object inside must match this schema. See config.example.js for a commented example and AI-GUIDE.md for how to fill it in.

eyebrow.description: Small caps line above the title, e.g. "WGU · Master of Science, Cybersecurity and Information Assurance".

goalNote.description: Optional text appended to the subtitle, e.g. "goal: finish in 2 terms".

storageKey.description: Key for saved progress in the browser. Changing it later makes existing progress invisible (it isn't deleted). Defaults to a slug of programName.

ratePerTerm.description: Tuition per term in US dollars. 0 or omitted hides the Budget card.

planOptions.description: Budget-card toggle. First entry is selected by default. Usually the planned term count first, then fewer-term stretches.

notes.description: Collapsible callouts under the header. html is inserted as-is, so only put trusted, simple HTML here.

color.description: CSS color, usually a variable like var(--money).

requirements.description: Things the program needs that are NOT courses and carry no CUs (content exams, state licensure steps, background checks).

id.description: Stable id; progress is saved under it. Don't change once in use.

term.description: The student's planned term for this course, not WGU's.

code.description: WGU course code like D482, or "" if unknown. Progress is saved by code, or by name when there's no code, so changing either after starting loses that course's progress.

notes.description: Extra note lines shown under the course.

cert.description: A certification that ALREADY satisfied this course by transfer (shows a badge). Use notes, not this field, for 'aligned with' or 'could transfer'.

transfer.description: true = already satisfied by transfer credit; no tracking.

inPerson.description: In-person part of the course. The course isn't complete until this part is. Students can also set it on the course card.

type.description: objective = OA (proctored exam), performance = PA (paper/project), n/a = transfer course. Program Guides never state this: use unknown unless a source says otherwise.

guess.description: true when the type comes from an unofficial source or inference, not WGU. Shows an '(unconfirmed)' pill.

tasks.description: Default task count for a performance assessment.

source.description: Who wrote it and whether it's official.
